styles.sprite: High-quality pre-rendered 3D CGI game sprite for a sci-fi browser MMO space shooter, NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector, NOT cartoon. Semi-realistic glossy hull with fine panel lines, specular highlights, ambient occlusion and soft cinematic studio lighting from the top-left, smooth anti-aliased edges, glowing emissive engines and lights. Strict top-down view seen from directly above, the front/nose of the ship pointing to the RIGHT side of the image, the engines at the LEFT side, perfect left-right bilateral symmetry along the horizontal axis, centered, filling about 80% of the canvas, fully transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no frame, single object only.
